parts.text:
**重大发现**：`r/selfhosted` 里提到 **"Reddit will also shut down the RSS feed on November 13th"** —— 这直接影响我的情报脚本。必须验证。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
 "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "function strip(s){ return String(s||'').replace(/<!\\[CDATA\\[/g,'').replace(/\\]\\]>/g,'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim(); }",
 "(async function(){",
 " // 抓 r/selfhosted 那条 Reddit RSS 关闭的帖子全文",
 " const r=await get('https://www.reddit.com/r/selfhosted/top/.rss?t=month');",
 " const es=r.body.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
 " for(const e of es){",
 " const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
 " const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
 " const title=strip(t?t[1]:'');",
 " const body=strip(ct?ct[1]:'');",
 " if(/RSS feed on November/i.test(title+body)){",
 " console.log('=== 找到相关帖 ===');",
 " console.log('TITLE:', title);",
 " console.log('BODY:', body.substring(0,2500));",
 " }",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-rssdown.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-rssdown.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch Reddit RSS shutdown post", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 6000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
  "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "function strip(s){ return String(s||'').replace(/<!\\[CDATA\\[/g,'').replace(/\\]\\]>/g,'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim(); }",
  "(async function(){",
  "  // 抓 r/selfhosted 那条 Reddit RSS 关闭的帖子全文",
  "  const r=await get('https://www.reddit.com/r/selfhosted/top/.rss?t=month');",
  "  const es=r.body.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
  "  for(const e of es){",
  "    const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
  "    const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
  "    const title=strip(t?t[1]:'');",
  "    const body=strip(ct?ct[1]:'');",
  "    if(/RSS feed on November/i.test(title+body)){",
  "      console.log('=== 找到相关帖 ===');",
  "      console.log('TITLE:', title);",
  "      console.log('BODY:', body.substring(0,2500));",
  "    }",
  "  }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-rssdown.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-rssdown.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch Reddit RSS shutdown post", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 6000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
